Compare the graph learner honestly against this stronger learned comparator.
prerequisite: Finish and freeze quantity-v2 selection before scoring this followup. No ELN or HTE outcomes examined.
representation: Four role-specific OR-combined 1024-bit radius-2 Morgan binary fingerprints plus unchanged 16 quantity conditions; no products or outcome-derived features.
split: Exactly same frozen three scaffold-grouped development folds and 610 reactions; test remains historically observed and unused for selection.
adoption: Retain quantity-v2 selected forest unless new candidate improves mean fold MAE by >=0.5 percentage points and wins >=2/3 matched folds. Select lowest eligible mean MAE; retain GNN selection unchanged.
limits: One fixed four-candidate representation comparison, no adaptive expansion or test-guided weights. Independent HTE evaluation only after combined procedure frozen.
